SOPA 340.d: This course provides students with a broad, introductory-level overview of the knowledge and skills necessary for preparing a public health response to epidemics or pandemics of infectious diseases. The course will use the recent pandemic, COVID-19 (coronavirus disease 2019), and the subsequent response efforts in the United States to provide context to covered topics.
SOPA 340.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 401.d: The capstone research seminar is a two-semester course taken in the final year of study. During the Spring Semester, the research teams will write up and present their final research report.
SOPA 401.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 477.d: Topics and credit hours may vary each semester. Contact department for current semester's topic(s). Repeatable for Credit.
SOPA 477.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 309.d: This course covers applications of statistics to policy analysis and evaluation. Topics include regression, limited dependent variable and selection models, and other estimation techniques appropriate for evaluation and causal inference.
SOPA 309.pre: SOSC 302 or STAT 310 or ECON 307 or STAT 315 or DSCI 301
SOPA 309.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 300.d: Students work on approved field research projects, write a research report for publication and present finding from their field research project to Rice faculty and staff. Recommended Prerequisite(s): POLI 338 or SOSC 301. Repeatable for Credit.
SOPA 300.pre: SOPA 200 and (SOSC 302 or STAT 310 or STAT 315)
SOPA 300.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 238.d: Topics and credit hours may vary each semester. Contact department for current semester’s topic(s). Repeatable for Credit.
SOPA 238.type: Internship/Practicum, Laboratory, Lecture, Seminar, Independent Study
SOPA 238.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 400.d: Students work in teams under the guidance of a Rice faculty member, researcher, or community partner (government, nonprofit, advocacy Organization, etc.) to evaluate or design a social policy intervention. Teams write a research report of publication quality and present findings at the end of the year.
SOPA 400.pre: (ECON 209 or SOSC 302) and (POLI 338 or SOSC 301) and SOPA 200 and SOPA 309
SOPA 400.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

SOPA 200.d: This course provides an introduction to the social sciences and the study of public policy. Students will review the nature of different disciplines and their research programs. These approaches will be studied as different paradigms for policy making.
SOPA 200.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
